name: Vanilla Minecraft
installScript:
apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq curl jq >/dev/null
MC_VERSION=${MC_VERSION:-latest}
MANIFEST=$(curl -s https://launchermeta.mojang.com/mc/game/version_manifest_v2.json)
if [ "$MC_VERSION" = "latest" ]; then
  MC_VERSION=$(echo "$MANIFEST" | jq -r '.latest.release')
fi
URL=$(echo "$MANIFEST" | jq -r --arg v "$MC_VERSION" '.versions[] | select(.id==$v) | .url' | head -1)
SERVER_JAR_URL=$(curl -s "$URL" | jq -r '.downloads.server.url')
echo "Downloading Vanilla $MC_VERSION"
curl -s -o server.jar "$SERVER_JAR_URL"
echo "eula=true" > eula.txt
